candidates.snippet: Macron says Russia’s hybrid threat to Europeans and France has intensified in recent weeks. He says France is stepping up vigilance and preparing a plan to protect critical infrastructure and key defense sites from possible drone and cyberattacks. https://t.co/vYhUwsJ4bJ
